nodes.title: SG-6.2 · Render LifecycleStepper in AdminApp with derived current stage
nodes.body:
Context: LifecycleStepper exists (game/frontend/src/components/LifecycleStepper.tsx) but AdminApp does not render it. Desired behavior: after the admin token is accepted, AdminApp shows the stepper with the current stage derived from the Round status and the current Round's execution status. Expected result: the admin sees where the Round is in OPEN → COMPLETED. Why: the admin needs a live lifecycle view.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an authenticated admin and an OPEN Round, when AdminApp loads, then the Round lifecycle stepper marks OPEN as the current step.
- Given a CLOSED Round whose execution is RUNNING, when AdminApp loads, then DEVELOPING is the current step.
- Given a unit test with mocked fetch, when it runs, then no real network is used.


## Scope
- In scope: Stage derivation helper
- In scope: AdminApp renders LifecycleStepper
- In scope: Unit tests with mocked fetch
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: ExecutionPanel wiring
- Out of scope: Approve/Retry wiring
- Preserve: Existing AdminApp token gate, round controls and contributions list
- Preserve: listExecutions, findExecutionForRound client functions


## Technical constraints
- Frontend only, game/frontend
- Reuse existing STAGES, stageIndex and listExecutions/findExecutionForRound


## Definition of done
- Stepper rendered in AdminApp and tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · A deriveStage helper maps Round and execution status to a lifecycle stage
nodes.body:
Context: stageIndex maps only Round status. Desired behavior: deriveStage(roundStatus, executionStatus?) returns the later of the Round-derived stage and the execution-derived stage (RUNNING→DEVELOPING, AWAITING_APPROVAL or APPROVED→PUBLISHING, COMPLETED→COMPLETED; QUEUED/FAILED add nothing). Expected result: a stage string usable as LifecycleStepper status. Why: Round status alone lags execution progress.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given roundStatus CLOSED and executionStatus RUNNING, when deriveStage is called, then it returns DEVELOPING.
- Given roundStatus OPEN and no execution status, when deriveStage is called, then it returns OPEN.
- Given roundStatus PUBLISHING and executionStatus RUNNING, when deriveStage is called, then it returns PUBLISHING (never moves backwards).


## Scope
- In scope: deriveStage export in LifecycleStepper.tsx
- Out of scope: Backend status changes
- Preserve: STAGES, stageIndex, LifecycleStepper behavior


## Technical constraints
- Execution statuses per backend/internal/execution/execution.go


## Definition of done
- deriveStage exported and typed


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · AdminApp renders LifecycleStepper for the current Round
nodes.body:
Context: AdminApp loads the admin Round and contributions after the token is entered. Desired behavior: it also lists executions, picks the one for the Round, and renders LifecycleStepper with deriveStage(round.status, execution?.status). Expected result: the stepper is visible with the right current step; a non-401 failure of the executions call leaves the stepper on the Round status. Why: live lifecycle view for the admin.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given token secret and an OPEN Round, when AdminApp loads, then list 'Round lifecycle' has exactly one aria-current step reading OPEN.
- Given a CLOSED Round and a RUNNING execution for that Round, when AdminApp loads, then the current step reads DEVELOPING.
- Given the executions endpoint returns 404, when AdminApp loads, then the stepper still shows the Round status stage and no error alert appears.
- Given the executions endpoint returns 401, when AdminApp loads, then the token gate shows Invalid token.


## Scope
- In scope: AdminApp.tsx load effect and render
- Out of scope: ExecutionPanel
- Out of scope: Backend
- Preserve: Token gate, Open/Close round, contributions list, existing admin tests


## Technical constraints
- Use listExecutions and findExecutionForRound from api/client.ts
- No new API


## Dependencies
- R1


## Definition of done
- Stepper rendered in AdminApp


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Add exported function deriveStage(roundStatus: string, executionStatus?: string): string. Compute execStage = executionStatus ? EXECUTION_STAGES[executionStatus] : undefined.
